searchText: Is anyone aware that Goerli network is down? And it appears that a subset of the <@&688101493978562687> validators have been offline for a few days now (200-219, 280-299). mine seems to be good Are you running the validators 200-219 and/or 280-299? no it does not seem to i am honestly not sure which ids are mine 🙂 but most of them are >300 and they run on one machine Ah, I was reading the table incorrectly. The downed validators 200-219 and 280-299 are owned by <@&836981603216654336> (Related: it would be great if <@199561711278227457> you could keep https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/sepolia up to date when new validators are assigned to make it easier to know who to talk to when validators go offline.)
